item.description:
OpenAccs now keeps the Claude app's settings the same in every Claude window, and windows of one account show the same limits.
- Windows signed in to the same account show the newest limits that any of them saved. The Claude app saves these numbers only from time to time, so for live limits with reset times, connect exact limits once per account. - The Claude app's own settings are the same in every window: its preferences, the permission mode of each folder, how new sessions start (model, effort and fast mode) and the chat MCP servers. When you change one in any window, OpenAccs copies it to the others. - The first time, OpenAccs gives every window the settings of your default Claude window and keeps the folder modes set in any of them. When you add a window, it gets the same settings. - OpenAccs can change a window's settings only while that window is closed, so an open window gets them when you restart it. - OpenAccs leaves the sidebar layout (group by, sort, show) alone, because Claude keeps it per account on its own servers and puts it back at every launch. Set it once in each account. - When you sign in to a different account in a window, OpenAccs shows the window under that account right away and copies your chats to it. - Setup no longer has a Claude app area, because OpenAccs now keeps those settings the same on its own.

Each Claude window keeps its own pinned chats.
- Chats, archive, permission mode, effort, Ultracode and model still sync between every window. - Pins sync only when you turn on Settings → General → Sync pinned chats. It is off by default. - Turning it on keeps every pin from every window, so nothing gets unpinned. - A new Claude window starts with no pins, unless pin sync is on.

Safer One setup. Apply and Undo are safe to use again.
- Undo is all or nothing. It waits while the app that owns the file is open, or while a later change still needs it. - Each Claude default applies on its own, and keeps what Claude Code changed in the same file meanwhile. - MCP servers: Codex configs stay loadable when a server changes from command to URL. Keys in arguments, URLs or a tool's own fields are never copied and never shown. One server Claude refuses no longer blocks the others. A side that was reset removes nothing from the other. - `openaccs vps`: keys and Mac-only settings stay off the server, and what you change on the server is kept on later runs. - An old ~/.agents.md that other tools link to is kept. Editing a linked CLAUDE.md keeps the link. Errors show where you are looking. - Messages name Claude windows the way OpenAccs does.
